role_archetype.rationale: The role combines a Lead Data Analyst identity and hands-on analytics competencies with a preferred legal-tech cyber incident review background, while explicitly distinguishing it from cybersecurity operations.

evidence_signals.name: Hands-on SQL and Python for data querying, data analysis, automation, and reporting

Domain-led candidates with Cyber Incident Review and/or Data Breach Analysis experience are the strongest target; capability-led Data Analysts without that domain experience are an acceptable alternative
Domain-led candidates may have a Lead or Senior Data Analyst identity and may be located anywhere in India, including remote within India; Power Query is not required for this alternative

Capability-led candidates must be Lead-level Data Analysts with at least six years of experience, hands-on SQL and Python, and working knowledge of Power Query, and must be located in Hyderabad or Pune
Working knowledge of Power Query for data transformation, preparation, and reporting is a lower proficiency expectation than hands-on SQL and Python
Cyber Incident Review and/or Data Breach Analysis experience
Background in Legal Tech, LPO, Legal Solutions, legal-services technology, Data Breach Analysis, or related evidence-backed environments
The team reviews cyber incidents and data breaches in a Legal Tech / Legal Solutions environment, rather than performing cybersecurity operations

Cybersecurity, SOC, Security Operations, Security Analyst, SIEM, Threat Detection, security incident response, and other cybersecurity operations experience do not establish equivalent Cyber Incident Review or Data Breach Analysis experience; the words cyber or incident alone are insufficient
Lead-level responsibility may be demonstrated through people leadership or technical leadership
Experience leading teams, mentoring analysts, and coordinating operational workflows
Review, quality assurance, compliance, audit, or security monitoring experience, without treating security monitoring alone as equivalent to the preferred legal-tech review domain
Strong analytical capabilities, attention to detail, and understanding of cybersecurity review processes in the legal-tech incident and breach review context
Reviewing and interpreting large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and potential security risks
Delivering high-quality review services with quality oversight, adherence to security standards, and compliance with established protocols
Collaborating with technology, security, legal, compliance, and business stakeholders on review findings and remediation
Preparing management reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to support data-driven operational and business decisions
Maintaining accurate documentation, procedures, audit trails, and quality records
Supporting the Review Manager with administration, resource planning, workflow prioritization, and team coordination
Coaching, developing, and providing ongoing feedback to team members
Driving continuous improvements in operational efficiency, quality, and compliance outcomes
Experience managing cyber incident reviews, breach investigations, or data privacy review workflows
An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered
